connectors.desc_gmail: Emails and PDF reports from a Gmail address.
connectors.desc_telegram: Messages and PDF reports to a Telegram chat or group.
connectors.gmail.note1: Work or school (Google Workspace) accounts, and accounts with Advanced Protection, often cannot create App Passwords. Use a dedicated Gmail address for Husk, or ask your administrator.
connectors.gmail.note2: If you change your Google password, Google revokes the App Password: Husk tells you with a suggestion and you create a new one.
connectors.gmail.note3: A personal Gmail account can send about 500 emails per day.
connectors.gmail.step1_body: Google only offers App Passwords on accounts with 2-Step Verification. Open your Google Account security page and switch it on.
connectors.gmail.step2_body: Open the App Passwords page, type a name such as “Husk” and press Create.
connectors.gmail.step3_body: Google shows it only once, in groups of four letters. Copy it now: spaces don't matter.
connectors.gmail.step4_body: In the next tab type the Gmail address and paste the code. Husk checks them with Google before saving.
connectors.gmail.step5_body: Press “Send test”: Husk sends a message to your own address. If it arrives, the connector is ready.
connectors.gmail.title: Gmail
connectors.secret_note: Stored only on this computer, in a private file in Husk's data folder. Never in the database, in backups or sent anywhere.
connectors.section_desc: How your automations send messages, emails and reports. Messages go from this computer straight to Telegram or Google, not through Husk's servers.
connectors.telegram.step1_body: BotFather is Telegram's official account for creating bots (it has a blue check). Open it with the button, or search for @BotFather in Telegram.
connectors.telegram.step2_body: Send /newbot, then choose a name (for example “Husk Officine”) and a username that ends in “bot”.
connectors.telegram.step3_body: BotFather replies with a token that looks like 123456789:ABC… Copy it: you paste it in Husk in the next tab. Treat it like a password, because anyone who has it controls the bot.
connectors.telegram.step4_body: Open your new bot in Telegram (BotFather gives you the link) and press Start, or send it any message. A bot cannot write to you before you do this.
connectors.telegram.step5_body: In Husk paste the token and press “Detect my chat”. To use a group instead, add the bot to the group and write a message there first.
connectors.telegram.step6_body: Press “Verify and save”, then “Send test”. If the message arrives in Telegram, the connector is ready.
connectors.telegram.tip1: Telegram messages are not end-to-end encrypted: do not send sensitive personal data.
connectors.telegram.tip2: A chat accepts about one message per second and a group 20 per minute: Husk slows down by itself.
connectors.telegram.title: Telegram

connectors.welcome_body: Connectors let your automations send messages, emails and reports. Set up the ones you need now (a few minutes each) or later in Settings → Connectors.
